name: grand_totals_with_levers_and_new_branch_split
purpose: Provide the headline like-for-like totals, core growth measures, and the separate current revenue from the new branch population.
intent: Return one row with comparable-population grand totals for [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Apply the like-for-like branch filter to all four branch-bearing tables using the exact branch codes CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021 on 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no], 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], and 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]. ROW(

    "LFL net revenue PAST", CALCULATE([net revenue PAST], TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]), TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]), TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]), TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no])),
    "LFL revenue Growth", CALCULATE([revenue Growth], TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]), TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]), TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]), TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no])),

name: latest_month_store_scorecard
purpose: Show the most recent month by branch so the summary can lead with the current branch pattern rather than only all-period totals.
intent: Identify the latest month from 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month] within the comparable population, then return up to 15 rows grouped by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] for that single latest month, with [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Apply the like-for-like branch filter to 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no], 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], and 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]. Sort by [revenue Growth] descending.
dax:
EVALUATE
VAR LatestMonth =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] )
    )
RETURN
TOPN (
    15,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
        'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no],
        TREATAS ( { LatestMonth }, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] ),
        "month", LatestMonth,
        "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
        "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
        "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
        "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
        "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
        "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
        "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
        "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
        "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
        "prior transactions", [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth],
        "bills growth", [bills growth],
        "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
        "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH],
        "SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]
    ),
    [revenue Growth], DESC
)

name: latest_month_division_breakdown
purpose: Summarize which divisions are driving the most recent month result across comparable branches.
intent: Identify the latest month from 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month] within the comparable population, then return the top 15 rows grouped by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[division_name] for that month with [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Apply the like-for-like branch filter to 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no], 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], and 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]. Sort by ABS([revenue Growth]) descending, breaking ties by [revenue Growth] descending.
dax:
EVALUATE
VAR LatestMonth =
    CALCULATE(
        MAX('MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no])
    )
RETURN
TOPN(
    15,
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[division_name],
            TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]),
            TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
            TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
            TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
            TREATAS({LatestMonth}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month]),
            "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
            "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
            "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
            "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
            "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
            "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
            "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
            "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
            "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
            "bills growth", [bills growth],
            "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
            "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH],
            "SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]
        ),
        "prior transactions", [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth],
        "abs revenue growth", ABS([revenue Growth])
    ),
    [abs revenue growth], DESC,
    [revenue Growth], DESC
)

name: category_health_measures
purpose: Quantify how many categories are declining and how much revenue they represent for the comparable business.
intent: Return one row with the category-health measures from 'CAT_TABLE': [COUNT], [COUNT_TOTAL], [COUNT_PLUS], [COUNT %], [sum deg cur rev], [sum deg past rev], [sum total cur rev], [sum total past rev], [contribution cur], and [contribution past]. No grouping; one row.
dax:
EVALUATE
CALCULATETABLE(
    ROW(
        "COUNT", [COUNT],
        "COUNT_TOTAL", [COUNT_TOTAL],
        "COUNT_PLUS", [COUNT_PLUS],
        "COUNT %", [COUNT %],
        "sum deg cur rev", [sum deg cur rev],
        "sum deg past rev", [sum deg past rev],
        "sum total cur rev", [sum total cur rev],
        "sum total past rev", [sum total past rev],
        "contribution cur", [contribution cur],
        "contribution past", [contribution past]
    ),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
    TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),

name: recent_daily_transactions_by_store
purpose: Add recent branch transaction trend context from the daily transactions table, which is only available for the current year.
intent: Return the top 15 rows grouped by 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE] and 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_CODE] for dates on or before the latest nonblank transaction date in 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE], restricted to branch codes CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021 in 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_CODE]. Compute true branch transactions from 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS] using a per-date per-branch de-duplicated aggregation rather than summing repeated row values. Sort by 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE] descending, then by the transaction result descending. This query is current-year only and is for recent context, not last-year comparison.
dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    15,
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        FILTER(
            SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
                'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE],
                'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_CODE],
                TREATAS(
                    { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" },
                    'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_CODE]
                )
            ),
            'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE] <= CALCULATE(
                MAX('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE]),
                FILTER(
                    'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt',
                    NOT(ISBLANK('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS]))
                )
            )
        ),
        "Transactions",
        CALCULATE(
            MAX('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS])
        )
    ),
    'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE], DESC,
    [Transactions], DESC
)

name: refresh_recency
purpose: State the data freshness visible in the model so the summary can say what period the numbers cover.
intent: Return one row with 'Latest_Refresh_Table'[MaxRefreshDate] and the [UPDATED_DATE] measure. No grouping, no filters, one row.
